title: Charge Limits and Balance Notice Terms by Meal Status — School Nutrition Services Meal Account
content:
These are the terms under the district's unpaid meal charge policy that govern how far a School Nutrition Services Meal Account may go below zero, what a student receives once that point is reached, and which notices the household is sent.

## Charging and charge limits

The charge limit is the largest negative balance an account may reach through charged reimbursable meals, stated as a positive amount (USD).

| Meal status | Reimbursable meal may be charged against a zero or negative balance | Charge limit, elementary | Charge limit, middle school | Charge limit, high school |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paid Meal Status | yes | 15.00 | 10.00 | 5.00 |
| Reduced-Price Meal Status (Prior-Year Carryover) | yes | 15.00 | 10.00 | 5.00 |
| Reduced-Price Meal Status | yes | 15.00 | 10.00 | 5.00 |
| Free Meal Status (Prior-Year Carryover) | no | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Free Meal Status (Household Application) | no | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Free Meal Status (Direct Certification) | no | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Free Meal Status (Categorical Eligibility) | no | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

What a student receives once the charge limit is reached, for every status: a reimbursable meal served and charged.

## Terms the same for every status

| Term | Value |
|---|---|
| A la carte items, second meals or milk may be bought when the balance would fall below zero | no |
| Low-balance notice threshold: balance at or below which a low-balance notice is sent while the balance is still zero or above | 5.00 USD |
| Calendar days between repeated negative-balance notices while the balance stays below zero | 7 |
| Unpaid meal charges carry into the next school year on the same account | yes |
| Collection letter sent for a negative balance remaining after the last instructional day | yes |
| Any fee, interest or penalty may be added to unpaid meal charges | no |

## Reading the table (hypothetical)

- A Paid Meal Status account at a high school reaches its charge limit when its balance stands 5.00 below zero; the same account at an elementary campus reaches it at 15.00 below zero.
- Accounts on any free status have a charge limit of 0.00 and no meal is charged against a zero or negative balance.
